rendering: modern TV anime cel shading, clean line art, two-tone shadows, vivid colours, detailed painted backgrounds, dramatic screentone-free digital finish
camera: anime shot grammar: extreme close-up on eyes for tension, low-angle hero shots, dutch tilt on reveals, speed-line backgrounds on action, still 'pillow shots' of the setting
lighting: hard rim light, dramatic backlight silhouettes, coloured ambient (sunset orange, night blue), lens flare on reveals
character_design_rules: Distinct hair silhouette and colour per character, a fixed eye colour and shape, one accessory as signature item. Faces stay on-model: same eye spacing, same jawline.
environment_rules: painterly backgrounds with atmospheric perspective, wires, signs (without readable text), rain-slick streets, cherry blossoms or neon as motifs
negative_prompt: 3D render, photorealistic, western cartoon, chibi (unless requested), extra eyes, readable text on signs
quality_tail: masterpiece, best quality, sharp line art

palette.palette_line: high contrast, deep shadows, one hot accent colour per scene

tier1.summary: push_in 1.00→1.12, occasional pan_lr on wide shots, allow hold (no motion) on 'pillow shots'

motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix: limited animation feel, hair and cloth sway, slow camera push, no lip flapping
